title: Find Minimum in Rotated Sorted Array
description: Find the minimum element in a rotated sorted array using binary search.

data.text: Given a sorted array that has been rotated between 1 and n times, return the minimum element. The algorithm must run in O(log n) time.
Scan for the smallest value. O(n) time, O(1) space.

data.title: Linear Scan O(n)

data.text: Compare mid with the right boundary. If mid > right, the minimum is in the right half; otherwise it's at mid or left. O(log n) time, O(1) space.

data.title: Binary Search O(log n)
What improved?
data.text: **Time:** O(n) → O(log n). **Space:** O(1). Because the array was originally sorted, binary search works on the rotated structure — compare mid to right, not left.
